metadata.note: Rail transit in Charlotte, North Carolina. The LYNX Blue Line opened on 24 November 2007 from uptown south to I-485, the first light rail in the Carolinas, and was extended north-east through NoDa to UNC Charlotte on 16 March 2018. The CityLYNX Gold Line, a genuine street-running streetcar rather than light rail, opened along Elizabeth Avenue and Trade Street on 14 July 2015 and was extended in 2021. Both carry one Charlotte Area Transit System colour under Rule 4 despite the Blue and Gold branding.
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lynx_Blue_Line (2007 opening, 2018 Blue Line Extension, 18.9 mi route)

metadata.not_yet_sourced: Headways and speeds are estimates. The Blue Line is drawn at its full post-2018 extent for the whole period since 2007 — the pre-extension southern-only line is not drawn separately, so the 2007–2018 years show more track than existed. The Gold Line's 2015 phase-1 extent is likewise not separated from the 2021 extension.
